dct_description_sm: This work is part of a larger project entitled Enhancing Resilience in a Changing Climate, which is addressing community-scale adaptive strategies and areas of risk, co-managed by the Government of Nunavut and Natural Resources Canada. The direct objective of the project is to assess the location, extent and characteristics of  landscape hazards affecting the community of Clyde River, Nunavut. The goal of this data   collection is to provide an assessment of potential ground instability and settling as a consequence of permafrost degradation.
dct_title_s: Shallow Permafrost Coring in Clyde River, Nunavut
